name: optcatalog_handle_impact_event_from_runtime_state
description: OptCatalog::HandleImpactEventFromRuntimeState builds a temporary hit event from runtime impact state and forwards it to OptCatalog::HandleImpactEvent.
known_limits: The wrapper creates temporary stack hit-event and surface-material records; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent OptCatalog impact-response source-cluster pass.
The forwarded impact handling itself is covered by optcatalog_handle_impact_event and its accepted callee targets.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4b0980 validates ECX as OptCatalogEntryDef*, EDX as OptCatalogRuntimeInstanceStorage*, runtimeInstance->pos copied to hitEvent.hitPos, a stack surface-material record assigned to hitEvent.surfaceRef with impact slot zero, runtimeInstance->projectileNode assigned to hitEvent.hitNode, and forwarding to OptCatalog::HandleImpactEvent with the original runtime instance.

The native OptCatalog smoke verifies the synthesized hit event reaches the impact callback with runtime position, projectile node, impact slot zero, and forwards through damage feedback with runtime-scaled damage.
